payload.claim: The comment cites "(§5.5)" for the claim that ruff flags str.split on a literal. DESIGN.md §5.5 is the REVIEW-phase section describing anchoring and the 54-common-word rule itself; it says nothing about ruff or the str.split/list-literal lint concern this sentence is making. The citation is attached to a lint-tool fact §5.5 does not discuss, so a reader checking the section for that claim finds nothing supporting it.
